title: Swap Adjacent in LR String
description: Determine if string start can be transformed into end by swapping 'XL' to 'LX' or 'RX' to 'XR'.
pseudocode:
1. i = 0, j = 0
2. while i < n and j < n:
3.   while i < n and start[i] == 'X': i++
4.   while j < n and end[j] == 'X': j++
5.   if i == n or j == n: break
6.   if start[i] != end[j]: return false
7.   if start[i] == 'L' and i < j: return false
8.   if start[i] == 'R' and i > j: return false
9.   i++, j++

steps.note: Initialize pointers i and j to 0
